target.title: docs: explain pull request automation workflow
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw contributors see Barnacle and ClawSweeper labels, comments, queue delays, proof requests, and re-review requests after opening a PR, but the contributor-facing workflow is not summarized in one OpenClaw docs page.

Closes #101172.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a practical pull request workflow guide for new contributors. It explains:

- what Barnacle does;
- what ClawSweeper does;
- how to ask ClawSweeper for another review;
- what `status: ⏳ waiting on author` means;
- what evidence/proof is useful;
- why proof redaction is the contributor's responsibility;
- why ClawSweeper may not respond immediately;
- how to troubleshoot and when to ask in `#clawtributors`.

It also adds a small `CONTRIBUTING.md` pointer and includes links to the ClawSweeper repo/docs for people or organizations that want to fork similar automation.

## User Impact

New contributors have a single place to understand the post-PR workflow instead of inferring it from bot comments, labels, Discord, and scattered docs.

## Evidence

Validation run locally:

```text
pnpm docs:check-mdx
pnpm docs:check-links
pnpm docs:map:check
pnpm format:docs:check
git diff --check
```

All passed.

## Review request

@clawsweeper review

ClawSweeper: because this page documents Barnacle and ClawSweeper behavior, please suggest any additions, corrections, or wording changes that would make the workflow clearer or more accurate for new contributors.
